hypotheses.claim: The projected Qwen3.5/libmtmd visual-token buffer can be a persistent MVC substrate only inside an explicitly compatible FeatureEpoch; silent prototype reuse across runtime/mmproj/backend/preprocessing/token-policy/pooling changes is unsafe until differential invariance is measured.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: MVC-E7 feature migration becomes enforceable at runtime and prevents stale familiarity from being mistaken for current perception.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The projected representation is invariant enough across semantically neutral runtime variations that binding every runtime/config field creates unnecessary prototype invalidation and relearning.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen-image cross-runtime matrix shows prototype transfer, open-set calibration and nearest-neighbor topology remain inside a predeclared tolerance despite changing runtime fields; ablate each FeatureEpoch field independently.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Use identical image bytes and exact model/mmproj across target llama.cpp commits and batch/backend settings; compare descriptor cosine drift, neighbor-rank correlation and classification transfer.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_true: At least one runtime/config transition causes material representation or calibration drift; stale-epoch rejection prevents false familiarity.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_false: Representation and calibration remain stable within tolerance across tested transitions; selected fields can be removed from compatibility identity after evidence.

hypotheses.claim: A Frank-local hook immediately after mtmd_batch_get_output_embd and before mtmd_helper_decode_image_chunk can classify familiarity/open-set state from the already-computed projected visual-token buffer and conditionally bypass language-model image decode without a second visual encode.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: It creates the smallest physical implementation of one-encode/zero-or-one-decode QNDRF and avoids a second heavy vision backbone.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The projected buffer is not sufficiently discriminative/calibrated or the decoder insertion is architecturally required too often for bypass to save meaningful end-to-end cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: Instrument exact target server: measure image encode, MVC gate, decode insertion and task outcomes; compare FULL_QWEN versus shared-buffer gate under identical frames.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Read-only tap plus descriptor calculation first; only then enable conditional bypass behind a feature flag.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_true: Repeated familiar states retain task correctness while a nontrivial fraction of changed visual cycles avoid decoder insertion and reduce sensor-to-state cost.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_false: Bypass rate is negligible or task/open-set errors increase outside tolerance.

hypotheses.claim: The exact Frank Qwen3.5-4B multimodal path requires a prompt-order x batch/ubatch x attention/backend regression matrix because current Qwen3.5/libmtmd failure evidence shows M-RoPE visual behavior can be configuration-sensitive in other family variants.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: Frank token API must not accept an image yet produce blank/irrelevant perception or crash as a silent function of runtime knobs.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The reported failures are confined to larger/MoE or already-fixed builds and do not transfer to the exact 4B dense target.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact 4B target passes frozen multimodal fixtures across declared supported runtime matrix and repeats after restart.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Start with production candidate settings plus one safe perturbation per dimension; include image-first and long-text-before-image cases.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_true: At least one supported-looking configuration changes visual correctness, crashes, falls back unexpectedly or changes feature fingerprints materially.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_false: Exact 4B target remains correct/stable across matrix; transfer risk can be closed as negative result for supported configurations.

hypotheses.claim: For Frank v0.1, llama-server parallel=1 is the simplest current baseline because the owner-fixed Frank execution contract permits exactly one active global execution lease, so extra model slots add failure surface without serving concurrent Frank executions.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: It aligns runtime topology with execution semantics and removes an avoidable parallel checkpoint/multimodal state dimension from initial acceptance.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Internal overlap/prefetch or non-user maintenance needs multiple llama slots even though Frank execution leases are serialized, and parallel=1 materially harms latency/resource utilization.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compare parallel=1 versus >1 under the same serialized Frank workload; require measurable benefit that cannot be achieved by safer internal scheduling before accepting >1.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Benchmark serialized request stream with parallel=1 and 2 while checking state/replay equivalence and resource cost.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_true: parallel=1 preserves throughput for serialized Frank requests and simplifies recovery with no task loss.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_false: parallel>1 improves relevant serialized workload performance materially without introducing state instability.

hypotheses.claim: Qwen3.5-4B resource receipts must account for the complete multimodal artifact/vision encoder rather than treating the 4B language-model label as the whole physical model cost.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: Q23 compares total sensor-to-action resource cost; model naming cannot substitute for RAM/VRAM/storage measurements.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The distinction is bookkeeping only and does not change any current target resource decision because the deployed GGUF/mmproj sizes are already measured directly.
hypotheses.falsifier: Current Frank receipts already bind exact text GGUF + mmproj sizes, resident memory and runtime allocation everywhere the 4B label is used for budgeting.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Audit current target model/mmproj artifacts and runtime RSS/VRAM against model labels.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_true: At least one planning/benchmark row undercounts the multimodal vision component when using nominal 4B size.
hypotheses.expected_signature_if_false: All relevant rows already use exact artifact/runtime footprints; record NO_CHANGE.
